prose: CrowdStrike Intelligence analyzes a campaign against South Korean financial organizations that led to data exfiltration. It says the attacker is likely Chinese-speaking and financially motivated, and used LLMs and ARTEX, an open-source Chinese agentic tool.
This is a vendor threat report, so attribution is an assessment. Only the Techmeme excerpt was reviewed.
highlights: Campaign against South Korean financial firms
Actor likely Chinese-speaking and financially motivated
Used LLMs and the open-source agentic tool ARTEX
